realce_dataset_provenance.explanation: Real-CE contains 945 paired (13mm, 52mm) full images in total: 645 pairs in official RealCE/train/ and 300 pairs in official RealCE/val/. scripts/split_realce_by_scene.py --split train ONLY splits the 645 official RealCE/train/ pairs by root scene ID (80% train / 20% internal val, seed=42), leaving all 300 official RealCE/val/ pairs 100% untouched for final test evaluation.
